history.period: Established as a national park in 1986; UNESCO Biosphere Reserve since May 2009
history.summary: FLAG - NOT A HINDU TEMPLE: "Nokrek National Park Temple" does not exist as any temple. Nokrek is a national park and UNESCO Man and the Biosphere (MAB) Reserve in the West Garo Hills of Meghalaya, built around Nokrek Peak (~1,412 m), the highest peak in the Garo Hills. It is a protected natural area famous as the gene sanctuary of Citrus indica (a primitive citrus) and home to red pandas, Asian elephants, hoolock gibbons, clouded leopards, and endemic flora - keep-or-drop decision needed for a Hindu-temples dataset. No shrine or temple inside the park is documented in any source consulted; the Garo tradition treats some peaks as sacred in an animist (Songsarek) sense, but there is no Hindu temple. CSV TOWN CORRECTION: the row's town "Williamnagar" is wrong - Williamnagar is the headquarters of East Garo Hills (planned town named after Capt. Williamson Sangma), while Nokrek National Park lies in WEST Garo Hills, with Tura as the nearest town. CSV district (if implied Meghalaya/East Garo Hills) is corrected to West Garo Hills.

name: Nokrek National Park (CSV row name: Nokrek National Park Temple)
town_description: Tura is the headquarters town of West Garo Hills, Meghalaya, about 323 km via Guwahati from Shillong. Nokrek National Park lies in the hills around Tura, reached via Daribokgre; the CSV town Williamnagar (East Garo Hills HQ) is incorrect.
tradition: Not a Hindu temple - a national park and UNESCO biosphere reserve; keep-or-drop decision needed.

travel.airport: Guwahati Airport is the usual gateway (~220-260 km); Shillong Airport is an alternative.
travel.railway: No railway station nearby; nearest major station is Guwahati, Assam.
travel.road: Reach Tura by road from Guwahati, then proceed to the park via Daribokgre/Rongram side. Forest permits and guides are required for trekking to Nokrek Peak.

visitor_information.best_time: October to April (dry season) for the Garo Hills.
visitor_information.opening_hours: National park - restricted entry; forest department permission required for the peak trek (verify locally). Note: coordinates point to the Nokrek/Daribokgre area of West Garo Hills.
